title: Undertale Began With a $5,000 Kickstarter. Chapter 7 Is Underway
hook:
Toby Fox asked Kickstarter for $5,000 in 2013 and 2,398 backers gave him $51,124; that game became Undertale. This week he said Deltarune Chapter 6 is playable from start to finish and work on Chapter 7 has begun. Which chapter is your favorite?
Gameplay is from Shards of Irsa, a game I'm making.
script: Did you know Undertale started with a Kickstarter that asked for just 5,000 dollars? In June 2013, Toby Fox put a small RPG on Kickstarter with a goal of 5,000 dollars. When it closed a month later, 2,398 backers had pledged more than 51,000 dollars. That was about ten times what he asked for. Fox built almost the whole game himself, bringing in other artists only for some of the art. Undertale came out in September 2015. A game about sparing monsters instead of killing them became one of the biggest indie hits of its decade. Then, on Halloween 2018, Fox dropped Deltarune Chapter 1 for free with about a day of warning. He has released the chapters one at a time ever since, and Chapter 5 arrived this past June as a free update. And this week Fox wrote in his newsletter that Chapter 6 is now a structurally complete draft you can play from beginning to end. Work on Chapter 7 has just started. A tiny Kickstarter has turned into a 13 year story that is still being written. Which chapter is your favorite? Follow for more gaming history.
